entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • JIT: Range check not eliminated by cast to value known to be in range #118305
    11.0.0

Closed

  • SharedArrayPool<char>.Rent sometimes erroneously returns the same array when called recursively #118292
  • Trimming analyzer false negative for Type property #113922
    10.0.0
  • WaitHandle doesn't do alertable waits #118233
    Future
  • `XmlSerializer` deserialize xml with parameterless struct constructors which implement `IXmlSerializable` will throw an exception #108660
  • Why are programs released by Native AOT easily treated as viruses by antivirus software? #118300
  • /p:PublishTrimmed=true activates Windows Defender with a false-positive. #33745
    Future

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix: Assert failure: Thread::IsObjRefValid #118307
    area-VM-coreclr
  • Start using parameter defined for ToString #118306
    area-Serialization
  • [RyuJit] Ignore missing SPMI data when printing string literals #118303
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • [NativeAOT] Implement Thread.Interrupt on Windows using QueueUserAPC #118302
  • [RuntimeAsync] Follow up for unboxing and instantiating stubs. #118301
    area-VM-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Add _UseNativeLibPrefix option for publishing a NativeAOT shared library on Unix #118299
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr

Merged

  • Move a couple of WASM threading files to the shared partition #118304
    arch-wasm, area-System.Threading, community-contribution
  • Standardize netfx test helper for pem encoding #118259
    area-System.Security, 10.0.0
  • [browser][AOT] active issue for AOT stack frames #118287
    arch-wasm, wasm-aot-test, area-Diagnostics-mono, os-browser, 10.0.0
  • Add support for patterns #118267
    linkable-framework, area-Tools-ILLink
  • [LoongArch64] Handle LASX/LSX/FP context depending on ISA availability. #118007
    area-PAL-coreclr, community-contribution, arch-loongarch64
  • Implement alertable waits for WaitHandle to support APC handling in NativeAOT #118256
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • [EventPipe][User_events] Add MetadataID and ProviderName to metadata bytes #118294
    area-Tracing-coreclr

Updated

  • Remove pinned XunitAnalyzersVersion from Versions.props #118241
    area-codeflow
  • EC-DSA Composite ML-DSA for net8+ #118232
    area-System.Security
  • [RyuJit] Mark some well-known indirs with some flags #118289
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • [browser] enable HttpStreamingDisabledBy_WasmEnableStreamingResponse_InProject test #118203
    arch-wasm, area-System.Runtime.InteropServices.JavaScript, os-browser, 10.0.0
  • arm64: Split GenerateHWIntrinsicTests_Arm.cs into smaller files #118157
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • Introduce size-optimized IListSelect iterator #118156
    area-System.Linq
  • Port the Shared Mutex logic from CoreCLR PAL to work alongside the managed wait subsystem #117635
    area-System.Threading, blocked, 11.0.0
  • Remove redundant write-barriers for stack-allocated arrays #118295
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • Remove leading plus sign validation from Version JSON deserialization #118207
  • Apx requirements for VM and GC stubs #116806
    area-VM-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Update host to use the optional localPath property when resolving assets #118297
    area-Host
  • [RISC-V] Move comparison transformations from codegen to lowering #118270
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution, arch-riscv
  • Return false in PropagateNeverToRuntime for BBJ_THROW blocks #118280
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • JIT: fix retyping of some storeinds during object stack allocation #118251
    needs-area-label
  • Remove a few array allocations from enumeration #118288
    area-Meta
